fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects cases in which an ISO files is opend within an archiver like 7Zip or Winrar, which is a sign of phishing as threat actors put small ISO files in archives as email attachments to bypass certain filters and protective measures (mark of web)
fields.name: Phishing Pattern ISO in Archive
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\\Winrar.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\7zFM.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\peazip.exe") and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\isoburn.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\PowerISO.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\ImgBurn.exe")))
